Zvi Benami Chunking Documents LLMs have a limited context window they can't process large documents all at once: Chunking solves this by splitting documents into manageable segments. Benefits of Chunking: Fitting into context window: Enables processing of long documents within token limits. Improved retrieval granularity: Allows semantic search at the paragraph or idea level, not the whole document: Reduces hallucinations: Ensures the LLM gets coherent and relevant context. Enhances accuracy in RAG pipelines: Better chunks better retrieval better answers. Supports streaming or partial updates: Only update or re-embed the modified chunks instead of the whole document: Enables re-ranking: Fine-grained chunks can be more accurately scored and re-ranked for relevance. Think of chunking as preparing high-quality bite-sized content for your LLM not too small; not too long, just right for comprehension and relevance.
